γιγνώσκω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise, understand; pres. 1 sg.: ’I know’
δίφροιο: δίφρος — stool, seat; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after ἐκ
δείδιθι: δείδω — fear, be afraid; rare perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’fear!’
δυσαέος: δυσαής — ill-blowing, of foul wind; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς), epithet of Zephyrus
εἰμὲν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσμέν)
εἴας: ἐάω — allow, permit, let; impf. 2 sg., augmented (ἐ- → εἰ-): ’you allowed’
θεά: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form): ’goddess!’
κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg.: ’a bad thing, evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’) · also neut. nom. sg. adjective agreeing with πέλωρ: ’evil’ (πέλωρ κακόν ’an evil monster’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun, predicate: ’an evil’ (ἀθάνατον κακόν ’an immortal evil’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun with a comparative, predicate: ’a greater evil’ (μεῖζον … κακόν)
κείνης: κεῖνος (= ἐκεῖνος) — that, that one; fem. gen. sg.
λοῦσεν: λούω — bathe, wash; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’bathed’
μέμηλεν: μέλω — be a care to (someone); perf. 3 sg. act. (pres. force), + dat.: ’is a care to’
μέμνημαι: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember; perf. 1 sg. mid. with present sense: ’I remember’
νεφέεσσιν: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic νέφεσιν)
νεφέων: νέφος — cloud; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεφῶν)
οἵη: οἷος — of such a kind, such as; in a simile ’as’; fem. nom. sg.
πήματ: πῆμα — woe, suffering, calamity; neut. acc. pl., elided (πήματ’ = πήματα)
παρεζόμενος: παρέζομαι — sit down beside; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα) · also masc. acc. sg. (παῖς is common gender; here of a son, Telemachus): ’son’ · also masc. acc. dual, elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδε), with δύο: ’two sons’
ταύτην: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; fem. acc. sg.
φαίνεθ: φαίνω (mid./pass.) — appear, show itself; pres. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (φαίνεθ’ = φαίνεται): ’appears’
φαμένη: φημί — say, speak; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’so saying’
χαρίεντα: χαρίεις — graceful, lovely; neut. acc. pl.
ἀΐδηλος: ἀΐδηλος — destroying, baneful (or ’unseen’: sense disputed); masc. nom. sg.
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνέξομαι: ἀνέχομαι — put up with, tolerate; fut. 1 sg. mid.
ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω
ἀὴρ: ἀήρ — mist, haze (in Homer; later ’air’); nom. sg., feminine in Homer (βαθεῖα ’deep’ agrees with it)
ἄνδρεσσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
ἅζεο: ἅζομαι — fear, shrink from, revere; impf. 2 sg. mid., unaugmented, uncontracted (= ἥζου): ’you shrank (from)’
ἐμμαπέως: ἐμμαπέως — quickly, readily, at once; adv. (formation uncertain)
ἐπέρεισε: ἐπερείδω — lean upon, press, put weight on; aor. 3 sg.: ’put (force) into it’
ἐπειγόμενος: ἐπείγω (mid.) — press on, hasten; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἐπικεύσω: ἐπικεύθω — hide further, keep back, conceal in addition; fut. 1 sg. · also aor. subj. 1 sg., short-vowel, with future sense: ’I will (not) hide’ (οὐδ’ ἐπικεύσω)
ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
ἕσσε: ἕννυμι — clothe, put clothes on; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-: ’clothed, put on’
ἥρης: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic Ἥρας)
ἰότητι: ἰότης — will, wish, favour; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the will of’
ὀλοφυρόμενος: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ) · also agreeing with ἔλαιον: ’liquid (oil)’ · also agreeing with μένος: ’wet (force)’
ὑπερφίαλον: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant, presumptuous; adj., neut. acc. sg.
ὑπὲκ: ὑπέκ — out from under, forth from beneath; prep. + acc.; here in tmesis with φύγοιμεν: ’flee out from under’ (ὑπὲκ κακότητα φύγοιμεν) · also + gen.: ’out from under’ (ὑπὲκ κακοῦ ’from under the evil’)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for which, to which’ (referring back to the ship, νηῦς) · also ’on which’, of a road: τὴν ὁδὸν ᾗ δὴ ’the journey on which’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀλόχῳ (ᾗ … ἀλόχῳ ’his own wife’) · also relative adverb of place, ’where, by which way’ (ᾗ οἱ Ἀθήνη πέφραδε ’where Athena had pointed out to him’)
